# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 0.7.1 - 2026-10-30

- The server URL is now fixed to `https://gitlab.com/api/v4/mcp`, and the **GitLab host** setting is removed. Self-managed GitLab instances are no longer supported.

## 0.7.0 - 2026-10-29

- Updated plugin version for marketplace release.

## 0.1.0 - 2026-10-26

- First version: GitLab remote MCP server over streamable HTTP.
